content: Degine, geb ilabogi, Bab-Jehová Jonásʼga gannar sogdebalid:
“¡Jonás! ¡Gwisgu! Nínive-neggwebur-dummadse be nae. An bega-ibmar-sogoed a-dulemarga be sognao.”
Agi Jonás, gwichibin imaksad, geb, Nínive-neggweburse nadegusad, Bab-Jehová-ega-sogsadba. Ar Nínive-neggwebur bipisursoggua, egi naegala ibapaa-nanaleged.
Jonás, Nínive-neggweburgi dognonikid, geb, ibagwen-dummad gandikidgi weyob sunmakdii gualid: “Iba-dulabose (40) Nínive-neggwebur berguoye.”

Agine, Nínive-dorgan Bab-Dummad-ega-sogedi nue-itosmalad. Degisoggu, serganmala, degi, bipiganase-bakar, bar mas-guchasurmalad, bela mor-sommed-ai-aid yosmarbalid, adi, oyogegar, emarde e-isguedga na wile-itomarye.

Nínive-e-rey we-gaya-itoargua, na e-rey-gangi-sii gwichibin-imaksad. Geb e-rey-mor-yoid-esusad, agi mor-sommereged yosad. Deginbali, buru-birgi sigisbalid, oyogegar, ede na e-isguedga bukib-binsamoye.

Geb degine, rey na e-dummaganmala, Nínive-neggweburginmaladga igar-uknonikid. Weyob sognonikid: “Bela dule-gwablemakar melle mas-gunmalo, melle dii gobmarbalo, bela molimarse-bakar, sibad-wawaadmarse-bakar, bela-ibmar-durganse-bakar, melle masgi-ogunmalo.

Deginbali, dulemar mor-sommed yomalo, degine, e-ibmar-durganse-bakale, egi mor-sommereged nasikmalo. Bab-Dummadse bela-bela gandikidgi gormalo. Degi, na war-wargwen e-daed-sunnasulid iemalo, degine, e-ibmar-isgana-sabsur-imakdimalad bela iemamarbalo.
Abakale, Bab-Dummad, wile anmar-dakalile. Bela-bela sabsur-anmar-odurdaksokalidgi, bar sabsur-anmar-odurdakarsulile, adi, melle anmar burgwemalagar.”
Bab-Dummad Nínive-dorgan e-isguedga na bukib-binsasa, degi, e-ibmar-isgana-imaked mete daksagua, na sognonisunnad, we-dulemar-osulogoye an sogsadi, emigindi, bar an sabsur-odurdakosurye.
